title: Jonah and the Compass
author: L. M. Delacroix
blurb: Paloma Vane, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the census taker asks one question too many, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
